answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 41321 Country: India Title: Can my mother offer salah on chair Question: My mother offers salah by sitting on chair and does sajdah on table because she is suffering from rheumatic arthritics, she cannot bend her knee. Is this right way to offer salah in this way? Answer ID: 41321 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1416/1425/M=1433) If your mother is not able to perform salah while standing with ruku and sajdah and it is also difficult to sit on the ground then she may offer salah sitting on chair but she should not use table for sajdah rather she should perform ruku and sajdah with gesture. And if she can offer salah while sitting on ground then she should not use chair. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
